note: Three roots, each its own census page, both sides for both themes (theme: light, then dark), on the mirror (http://localhost:4184/geist/dots-menu) and the census page (http://localhost:4180/census/dots-menu). The trigger (the composed menu button, read on its button part through the host) is read on every example: the page's four closed ones and the two sketched open ones. The list and the item roots exist on the open examples only; ours opens them in `prepare` (the dots menus of the census-only previews, the last two) before the census freezes transitions. The item's highlight is the data-selected state. Inject census.js on the census page first (a script element with src http://localhost:4183/census.js); the mirror carries it.

ours.prepare: const p=[...document.querySelectorAll('.showcase .preview')].slice(4).flatMap(x=>[...x.querySelectorAll('acme-dots-menu')]);for(const el of p)el.open=true;return Promise.all(p.map(async el=>{await el.updateComplete;const m=el.shadowRoot.querySelector('acme-menu');await m.updateComplete;await m.updateComplete;}));
